label: Phase 2 repair services/actions.py RBAC checks, string list comparisons, and balance updates
instruction: Fix the bugs in modules/leave_elm/services/actions.py: (1) Import `timedelta` from `datetime`, `Decimal` from `decimal`, `transaction` from `django.db`, `timezone` from `django.utils`, `BadRequestError, DomainError, NotFoundError, PermissionDeniedError` from `core.api.exceptions`, `LEAVE_POLICY_DEFAULTS` from `modules.leave_elm.domain.policy`, and `LeaveApplication, LeaveBalance, LeaveExtension, LeaveHistory, LeaveNotification, LeaveResumption, LeaveSubstitution, LeaveTask` from `modules.leave_elm.models`. Do NOT reference `User.objects` or `actor.notify_leave_status`! (2) Remove `if actor.kind != 'faculty' and actor.kind != 'staff'` so admin/authority principals can also act. Instead check RBAC per action using `actor.has_permission(...)`! (3) Keep the entire `act_on_application(actor, application_id, action, data=None)` inside `with transaction.atomic():` and fetch `leave_app = LeaveApplication.objects.select_for_update().select_related('leave_type', 'leave_type__leave_category').get(id=application_id)` (raising `NotFoundError` on `LeaveApplication.DoesNotExist`). Set `data = data or {}` and if `isinstance(data.get('data'), dict)` merge it. (4) Helper `_adjust_balance(user_id, leave_category, delta_days)`: `bal, _ = LeaveBalance.objects.select_for_update().get_or_create(user_id=user_id, leave_category=leave_category, defaults={'balance': Decimal(str(LEAVE_POLICY_DEFAULTS.get(leave_category.name, 8)))})`; `new_val = bal.balance + Decimal(str(delta_days))`; if `delta_days < 0 and new_val < 0`: `raise DomainError('Insufficient leave balance')`; `bal.balance = new_val; bal.save(update_fields=['balance', 'updated_at'])`. (5) Action branches (use `in (...)`, NEVER `!= [...]`!): - `'substitute_accept'` / `'substitute_reject'`: require `actor.has_permission('leave_elm.substitute.respond')`; update `LeaveSubstitution.objects.filter(leave_application=leave_app, substitute_user_id=actor.user_id)` (if empty and `leave_app.academic_substitute_user_id != actor.user_id` and `leave_app.admin_substitute_user_id != actor.user_id`, raise `PermissionDeniedError`); if `'substitute_accept'`, set substitution status `'Accepted'`, close substitute task, and if no pending substitutions remain set `leave_app.status = 'Pending'` and create `'Application Review'` task for `role='reviewer'`; if `'substitute_reject'`, set substitution status `'Rejected'` and `leave_app.status = 'Returned for Clarification'`. - `'recommend'` / `'forward'`: require `actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.review')` and `actor.user_id != leave_app.user_id` (else `PermissionDeniedError`); require `leave_app.status in ('Pending', 'Under Review')` (else `DomainError`); set `leave_app.status = 'Awaiting Sanctioning Authority'`, `leave_app.reviewed_by_id = actor.user_id`, `leave_app.reviewed_at = timezone.now()`, and create `'Sanction Decision'` task with `role='authority'`, `status='Pending'`, `user_id=actor.user_id`. - `'return_clarification'`: require `actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.review') or actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.approve')`; set `leave_app.status = 'Returned for Clarification'`. - `'approve'`: require `actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.approve')` and `actor.user_id != leave_app.user_id` (else `PermissionDeniedError`); require `leave_app.status in ('Pending', 'Under Review', 'Awaiting Sanctioning Authority')` (else `DomainError`); if not `leave_app.balance_deducted`, call `_adjust_balance(leave_app.user_id, leave_app.leave_type.leave_category, -leave_app.working_days)` ONCE and set `leave_app.balance_deducted = True`; set `leave_app.status = 'Approved'`, `leave_app.approved_by_id = actor.user_id`, `leave_app.approved_at = timezone.now()`. - `'reject'`: require `(actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.review') or actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.approve')) and actor.user_id != leave_app.user_id` (else `PermissionDeniedError`); require `leave_app.status in ('Pending', 'Under Review', 'Awaiting Sanctioning Authority', 'Substitute Pending')` (else `DomainError`); set `leave_app.status = 'Rejected'`. - `'withdraw'`: require `actor.user_id == leave_app.user_id` (else `PermissionDeniedError`); require `leave_app.status in ('Draft', 'Pending', 'Substitute Pending', 'Under Review', 'Returned for Clarification')` (else `DomainError`); set `leave_app.status = 'Cancelled'`, `leave_app.cancelled_by_id = actor.user_id`, `leave_app.cancelled_at = timezone.now()`. - `'cancel'`: require `actor.user_id == leave_app.user_id or actor.has_permission('leave_elm.application.approve')` (else `PermissionDeniedError`); require `leave_app.status == 'Approved'` (else `DomainError`); if `leave_app.balance_deducted`, call `_adjust_balance(leave_app.user_id, leave_app.leave_type.leave_category, leave_app.working_days)` (POSITIVE to restore balance!) and set `leave_app.balance_deducted = False`; set `leave_app.status = 'Cancelled'`, `leave_app.cancelled_by_id = actor.user_id`, `leave_app.cancelled_at = timezone.now()`. - `'extend'`: require `actor.user_id == leave_app.user_id` (else `PermissionDeniedError`); require `leave_app.status == 'Approved' and not leave_app.extension_requested` (else `DomainError`); set `leave_app.extension_requested = True`, `leave_app.extension_start_date = leave_app.end_date + timedelta(days=1)`, `leave_app.extension_end_date = leave_app.end_date + timedelta(days=2)`, create `LeaveExtension` and `'Extension Approval'` task. - `'resume'`: require `actor.user_id == leave_app.user_id` (else `PermissionDeniedError`); require `leave_app.status == 'Approved'` (else `DomainError`); set `leave_app.resumed_at = timezone.now()`, `leave_app.status = 'Completed'`, create `LeaveResumption`. (6) Always call `leave_app.save()`, create `LeaveHistory(user_id=actor.user_id, leave_application=leave_app, action=action, status=leave_app.status, decision=decision_text)`, create `LeaveNotification(user_id=leave_app.user_id, leave_application=leave_app, message=f'Application #{leave_app.id} {action}: {leave_app.status}')`, and return `leave_app`. Return only valid Python code.
